Net profit margins climbed to 12.7%, up from 9.1% a year ago, and the company’s earnings quality remains high. Looking forward, forecasts call for 7.8% annual earnings growth and a 3.6% yearly rise in revenue, though both rates lag behind the broader US market. The company expects next quarter’s revenue to be around $1.64 billion, close to analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.81 per share was 10.1% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
